question:
Select the appropriate word form:

The sudden announcement caused widespread ____ among employees.
solution:
The correct answer is '**confusion**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**confusion**" is a noun and perfectly fits the context of the sentence, describing the state caused by the sudden announcement.
 
• Option 1 "**confuse**" is a verb and does not fit grammatically in this context.
